雾霾、温室效应、城市热岛与臭氧层：气候与大气环境Haze, Greenhouse Effect, Urban Heat Island and the Ozone Layer: Climate and Air Environment

区分雾滴与 PM2.5 细颗粒物及其健康防护；用辐射强迫、水汽与反照率反馈和气候敏感度量级解释增强温室效应；比较城乡蓄热差异说明夜间城市热岛；梳理 CFC 光解、氯催化破坏臭氧与蒙特利尔议定书后的恢复趋势。Fog versus PM2.5 and protection; greenhouse forcing, feedbacks and climate sensitivity; night-time heat island from heat storage; CFC chlorine ozone loss and Protocol recovery.

01雾和霾是一回事吗？霾天为什么要关窗、做防护？Are fog and haze the same, and why close windows and protect yourself on hazy days?

雾是高湿度液态水滴，霾是干细颗粒；PM2.5 ≤2.5 µm 沉积肺泡，指南 5 µg/m³，需关窗净化与口罩。Fog is liquid droplets at high humidity; haze is dry fine particles. PM2.5 ≤2.5 µm deposits in alveoli, guideline 5 µg/m³ annual, needing closed windows, purifiers and masks.

雾是近地面空气中的水汽凝结成的小液滴。空气湿度接近饱和时，多余水汽在凝结核上形成微米级液滴，悬浮在低层大气中散射光线，使能见度下降。雾滴以液态水为主，天气转晴、日出后地面升温，液滴蒸发，雾就逐渐消散。雾多呈白色或灰色，厚度和范围随湿度与层结变化。Fog forms when near-surface water vapour condenses into small liquid droplets. When humidity approaches saturation, excess vapour forms micron-scale droplets on condensation nuclei, suspended in the lower atmosphere and scattering light to cut visibility. Fog droplets are mainly liquid water; as the ground warms after sunrise under clearing skies the droplets evaporate and the fog dissipates. Fog looks white or grey, its depth and extent varying with humidity and layering.[1]

霾是干细颗粒物混在空气中形成的浑浊现象。其中可吸入细颗粒物 PM2.5 指空气动力学直径不超过 2.5 µm 的颗粒，能绕过鼻毛和气道沉积到肺泡，部分细小颗粒还可进入血液循环。来源包括燃煤与工业排放、机动车尾气、扬尘，以及气态污染物在大气中反应生成的二次气溶胶。霾粒多为固态或液态干颗粒，偏灰黄，持续时间往往比雾长。Haze is murk from dry fine particles mixed into the air. Fine PM2.5 particles are those with aerodynamic diameter no larger than 2.5 µm; they bypass nose hairs and airways to deposit in alveoli, and some tiny particles enter the bloodstream. Sources include coal and industrial emissions, vehicle exhaust, dust, and secondary aerosols formed when gaseous pollutants react in the atmosphere. Haze particles are mostly solid or dry liquid granules, grey-yellow, and often last longer than fog.[1][2]

两者经常被混叫成“雾霾”，但形成条件不同。雾依赖高湿度和液态水滴，容易在升温后消散；霾依赖细颗粒物浓度，在干燥或潮湿条件下都可能出现。同一城市可以先起雾、后转霾，也可以雾滴与颗粒混合在一起。区分要看相对湿度、粒子状态和持续时间，不能只凭天色发灰判断。The two are often lumped as "smog" but form under different conditions. Fog relies on high humidity and liquid droplets and clears after warming; haze relies on fine particle concentration and can occur in dry or damp air. A city may fog first then turn hazy, or carry a mixture of droplets and particles. Distinguishing them needs relative humidity, particle state and duration, not just a grey sky.[1]

细颗粒物对健康的影响与粒径有关。PM2.5 沉积部位深、停留久，可刺激呼吸道并加重心血管负担；世界卫生组织 2021 年空气质量指南把 PM2.5 年平均浓度指导值定为 5 µg/m³。霾天应关闭门窗、使用带活性炭或高效过滤层的净化器，外出佩戴符合防护等级的口罩，减少剧烈户外活动；儿童、老人和心肺疾病患者更敏感，应缩短户外停留时间，敏感人群尤其需要关注空气质量预报。Health impact tracks particle size. PM2.5 deposits deep and stays long, irritating airways and adding cardiovascular burden; the WHO 2021 air-quality guideline sets the PM2.5 annual mean guideline at 5 µg/m³. On hazy days close windows, use purifiers with activated carbon or high-efficiency filters, wear a properly rated mask outdoors, and reduce strenuous outdoor activity; sensitive groups should follow air-quality forecasts closely.[1][2][3]

边界：能见度低不等于都是霾，雾、扬尘、炊烟和烟花余烬都会降低能见度。口罩对较大颗粒有效，对细颗粒物的防护取决于过滤等级与密合度，普通棉布口罩防护有限。空气质量应按质量浓度和成分判断，天色偏黄或偏灰只能作为直观提示；预报等级通常依据 PM2.5、PM10 等污染物浓度综合划定，不能替代监测数据。Boundary: low visibility is not always haze — fog, dust, cooking smoke and fireworks residue all reduce it. Masks trap larger particles; fine-particle protection depends on filter rating and seal, and ordinary cloth masks offer limited defence. Air quality should be judged by mass concentration and composition; a yellowish or grey sky is only a visual hint, not a substitute for monitoring data.[1][2]

02温室效应是什么？为什么二氧化碳增加会让地球变暖？反馈和气候敏感度是什么量级？What is the greenhouse effect, why does more CO2 warm the Earth, and what are feedbacks and climate sensitivity in magnitude?

温室气体吸收长波并向下回辐射；AR6 总强迫约 +2.72 W/m²，ECS 最佳估计约 3°C。GHGs absorb longwave and radiate back down; AR6 total forcing about +2.72 W/m², ECS near 3°C.

自然温室效应是地球宜居的基础。太阳短波辐射穿过大气到达地面，地面升温后以长波红外辐射向外散热；水汽、二氧化碳、甲烷等温室气体吸收一部分长波辐射，再向下回辐射，把热量留在低层大气和地表。如果没有大气的温室作用，地球表面平均温度大约只有 −18°C，而当前地表均温约 15°C，差额主要来自自然温室效应。The natural greenhouse effect keeps Earth habitable. Shortwave sunlight reaches the surface, which warms and radiates heat back as longwave infrared; water vapour, carbon dioxide and methane absorb part of this longwave radiation and radiate it downward, holding heat in the lower atmosphere and surface. Without an atmospheric greenhouse, the global mean surface temperature would be about −18°C; the present mean is near 15°C, the difference mostly from the natural greenhouse effect.[3]

人类活动增强了这一效应。燃烧化石燃料、毁林和工业过程提高了大气中 CO2 等温室气体浓度，向下的长波回辐射增强，地球能量收支出现盈余，多余能量由地表和海洋吸收，推动全球升温。辐射强迫用来衡量这种扰动：IPCC 第六次评估报告评估，2019 年相对 1750 年总人为有效辐射强迫约为 +2.72 W/m²，其中 CO2 约贡献 +1.4 W/m²。Human activity has strengthened this effect. Fossil fuel burning, deforestation and industry raise atmospheric CO2 and other greenhouse gas concentrations, strengthening downward longwave back-radiation and leaving an energy budget surplus absorbed by land and ocean, driving warming. Radiative forcing measures this perturbation: IPCC AR6 assesses total anthropogenic effective forcing in 2019 relative to 1750 at about +2.72 W/m², with CO2 contributing about +1.4 W/m².[3][5]

气候反馈会放大或削弱初始强迫。水汽是正反馈：气温升高使大气持水量增加，水汽本身又是温室气体，进一步增强温室效应。冰雪反照率反馈也是正向：冰雪融化后露出深色海面和陆地，吸收更多太阳辐射，加速升温。云的反馈方向和幅度受云型、高度和相态影响，仍是气候预测中不确定性较大的部分。Climate feedbacks amplify or weaken the initial forcing. Water vapour is a positive feedback: warmer air holds more moisture, and water vapour itself is a greenhouse gas, strengthening the effect. The ice-albedo feedback is also positive: melting ice exposes dark ocean and land that absorb more sunlight, accelerating warming. Cloud feedback direction and magnitude depend on cloud type, height and phase and remain a major uncertainty in projections.[5]

平衡气候敏感度（ECS）指 CO2 浓度加倍后达到平衡时的全球地表升温。IPCC AR6 给出的最佳估计约 3°C，可能区间 2.5–4°C，很可能区间 2–5°C。观测方面，相对工业化前，全球地表平均温度已经上升约 1.1–1.2°C，这一趋势由 NASA、NOAA 等机构的地表与海面温度序列相互印证。Equilibrium climate sensitivity (ECS) is the global surface warming at equilibrium after CO2 doubles. IPCC AR6 gives a best estimate near 3°C, a likely range of 2.5–4°C and a very likely range of 2–5°C. Observations show global surface temperature has risen about 1.1–1.2°C above pre-industrial levels, corroborated across NASA and NOAA land and sea-surface temperature series.[4][5]

边界：自然温室效应本身不是污染问题，没有它地球会过于寒冷；被讨论的是人类排放造成的增强部分。辐射强迫是能量收支扰动，不等于已经发生的瞬时升温，升温还受海洋热惯性和反馈节奏影响。敏感度区间来自气候模式、器测记录与古气候证据的综合，不能把最佳估计当成确定值。Boundary: the natural greenhouse effect is not itself pollution; without it Earth would be too cold, and what is debated is the human-amplified part. Radiative forcing is an energy-budget perturbation, not the instantaneous warming already realised, which also depends on ocean heat inertia and feedback pace. The sensitivity range combines models, instrumental records and palaeoclimate evidence; the best estimate is not a fixed value.[5]

03城市“热岛”为什么往往在夜里更明显？Why is the urban heat island often more noticeable at night?

建材白天蓄热夜间缓慢释放，乡村靠蒸发快速散热；日落后城区余温、阻风与人排热使温差拉大，典型 1–3°C。Materials store heat by day and release it slowly; rural areas cool by evaporation, so retained warmth and blocked wind widen the night gap.

城市热岛指城区温度明显高于周边乡村的现象。城乡温差在白天和夜间都可能出现，典型幅度约 1–3°C；在晴朗、无风的夜间，城区与郊区的温差可以更大。热岛是局地城乡对比，观测时要在相近气候背景下、避开局部热源点位进行比较。The urban heat island is the phenomenon where city temperatures sit clearly above surrounding countryside. The difference appears day and night, typically about 1–3°C, and can be larger on clear, calm nights. It is a local urban-rural contrast, measured under a similar climate background and away from local heat-source spots.[6]

蓄热能力差异是主因。混凝土、沥青和砖石建材比热容与密度较大，白天吸收并储存大量太阳辐射；沥青、混凝土白天表面温度可比乡村裸露土壤高出十余度，建材导热慢，热量先存入内部而不是立刻散出。乡村土壤含水多、植被覆盖高，通过蒸腾和蒸发把热量带走，储存的热量较少。到了夜间，城区建材把白天积蓄的热量缓慢释放，乡村则靠蒸发和长波辐射较快降温。Differences in heat storage drive it. Concrete, asphalt and brick have relatively high specific heat and density, absorbing and storing large amounts of sunlight by day; rural soil holds moisture and vegetation, which move heat away through transpiration and evaporation and store less heat. At night, urban materials release the day's stored heat slowly, while the countryside cools quickly through evaporation and longwave radiation.[6]

热岛在日落后数小时往往更明显。白天城乡都在接收日照，差距被太阳辐射掩盖；日落后乡村迅速散热，城区建筑余温持续释放，再加上高楼阻挡通风、空调和交通与工业的人为排热，城区降温速度明显慢于郊区，温差被拉大。夜间城市道路和建筑仍向外长波辐射，但内部储热持续补充，降温曲线平缓；郊区缺少这种蓄热体，日落后温度下滑更快。夜间保留下来的余温也是城市夜间闷热的重要来源。The island often sharpens in the hours after sunset. By day both city and country receive sunlight, masking the gap; after dark the country cools rapidly, while urban building heat keeps releasing, tall buildings block ventilation, and waste heat from air conditioning, traffic and industry slows the city's cooling. The retained night warmth is a major source of urban nighttime stuffiness.[6]

缓解途径围绕减少蓄热和增加散热。增加树木、草坪和水体，推行屋顶绿化和透水铺装，使用浅色反射路面与屋面，都能降低地表吸热、增强蒸发与散热。水体和植被通过蒸发蒸腾持续耗热，树荫还降低地表接收的直射辐射；浅色屋面反射短波，减少建材蓄热。风速越大，城区与郊区空气混合越好，热岛效应越弱；开阔通风的街道布局也有助于夜间散热。Mitigation targets less storage and more dissipation. Trees, lawns and water bodies, green roofs, permeable pavements and light-coloured reflective roads and roofs all lower surface absorption and enhance evaporation and cooling. Stronger wind mixes urban and rural air and weakens the island; open, ventilated street layouts also help nighttime cooling.[6]

边界：城市热岛是城区与周边的局地温差，不等同于全球气候变化，两者时间尺度和空间范围不同。夜间温差大不代表白天城区最热，白天的温差常被强日照和边界层混合抹平。热岛强度随天气、季节和下垫面类型变化，单次观测不能代表长期平均。Boundary: the urban heat island is a local city-to-countryside contrast, not the same as global climate change, differing in time scale and spatial extent. A large night gap does not mean the city is hottest by day, when strong sunlight and boundary-layer mixing often erase the contrast. Island strength varies with weather, season and surface type, so a single observation does not represent the long-term average.[3][4][6]

04氟氯烃（CFC）为什么会破坏臭氧层？议定书之后恢复得怎样？How do CFCs damage the ozone layer, and how is recovery going after the Protocol?

CFC 升入平流层光解释放氯，催化循环破坏臭氧；议定书淘汰 ODS，预计 21 世纪中后期恢复。CFCs release chlorine in the stratosphere that catalytically destroys O3; the Montreal Protocol phased out ODS, recovery projected mid-to-late century.

臭氧层位于平流层。臭氧分子主要集中在距地面约 15–35 km 的平流层，吸收太阳紫外辐射中的 UV-B 波段（约 280–315 nm），保护地面生物免受强紫外线损伤。需要区分的是，近地面对流层臭氧是光化学烟雾的组成部分，属于污染物，与保护生命的平流层臭氧不是同一回事。The ozone layer sits in the stratosphere. Ozone molecules concentrate about 15–35 km above the surface, absorbing UV-B ultraviolet radiation (roughly 280–315 nm) and shielding surface life from strong UV damage. A distinction matters: tropospheric ozone near the ground is part of photochemical smog and a pollutant, not the life-protecting stratospheric layer.[7][8]

氟氯烃（CFC）曾广泛用作制冷剂、发泡剂和气雾剂推进剂。这类物质在对流层化学性质稳定、大气寿命长，可达数十年至上百年，不容易在低层分解，逐步随大气环流升入平流层。到达平流层后，强烈紫外线照射使 CFC 分子光解，释放出氯原子。Chlorofluorocarbons (CFCs) were once widely used as refrigerants, foaming agents and aerosol propellants. Chemically stable with long atmospheric lifetimes, they do not break down easily in the lower atmosphere and rise gradually with circulation into the stratosphere. There, intense ultraviolet light photolyses the CFC molecules and releases chlorine atoms.[7]

氯原子以催化方式破坏臭氧。基本反应是 Cl + O3 → ClO + O2，随后 ClO + O → Cl + O2，氯原子在反应中被重新释放，可以循环参与，一个氯原子能破坏上千个臭氧分子。南极冬季极夜形成极地平流层云，冰粒表面的非均相反应把储存氯转化为活性形态；春季日出后活性氯集中攻击臭氧，形成季节性的南极臭氧洞。Chlorine destroys ozone catalytically. The basic reactions are Cl + O3 → ClO + O2, then ClO + O → Cl + O2; the chlorine atom is released again and cycles through many times, one chlorine destroying up to a thousand ozone molecules. Ice particles on Antarctic stratospheric clouds in winter accelerate chlorine activation, and spring warming releases it in a burst that forms the seasonal ozone hole.[7]

1987 年签署的《蒙特利尔议定书》及其修正案逐步限制并淘汰 CFC 等消耗臭氧层物质。除 CFC 外，哈龙、四氯化碳、甲基溴等也受议定书管制，后续修正案逐步纳入 HCFC、HFC 等替代品并评估其气候与毒性影响。观测显示平流层氯浓度已经由峰值下降，臭氧层有望在 21 世纪中后期逐步恢复到 1980 年前水平。这一议定书被广泛视为国际合作解决环境问题的成功案例。The 1987 Montreal Protocol and its amendments restricted and phased out CFCs and other ozone-depleting substances. Observations show stratospheric chlorine has fallen from its peak, and the ozone layer is projected to recover toward 1980 levels by the mid-to-late 21st century. The protocol is widely regarded as a successful case of international environmental cooperation, with later amendments adjusting the list as substitute impacts emerge.[8]

边界：平流层臭氧保护生命，对流层臭氧危害健康，两者不能混为一谈。CFC 同时也是温室气体，淘汰它们既修复臭氧层也有减暖效益；替代物质的温室效应、毒性和可燃性也需要逐一评估。南极臭氧洞每年春季出现、随后闭合，是极寒条件与大气环流共同作用的结果。臭氧恢复是缓慢过程，受累积排放、大气环流和气候变暖影响，不能按单一季节观测判断趋势。Boundary: stratospheric ozone protects life while tropospheric ozone harms health; the two must not be conflated. CFCs are also greenhouse gases, so phasing them out both repairs the layer and reduces warming; substitutes must be assessed one by one for greenhouse effect, toxicity and flammability. Ozone recovery is slow, shaped by cumulative emissions, circulation and climate warming, so a single season's observation cannot set the trend.[3][7][8]
